poc.scope: Q2 basic scenario: building graph from Figure 1, discrete-event route simulator, exact enumeration of 2-responder partitions as independent cross-check
poc.command: python3 code/sweep.py (bundled python 3.12.14, scipy 1.18.1 not required for PoC)

results.exact_assignment: FF1 from exit 0: S1,N1,N2; FF2 from exit 1: S3,N3,S2

decisions: PIVOT: Q2 primary model changed from side-partition heuristic to exact enumeration, because the heuristic is 14.3% above optimum (110.7s vs 96.8s). Basic scenario (6 rooms, 2 responders) is small enough for exact enumeration.
Simulator (route times + sweep_partition) validated by exact-plan replay consistency (96.8s = 96.8s).

acceptance_check.evidence: single-greedy 171.4s vs exact 96.8s on identical graph/params
replay of exact orders reproduces exact makespan
